how are psionics determined?
Psionics are granted randomly at remort 2, 3, and 4—one power from each of the four disciplines per remort—and all 17 powers unlock at remort 5.
what are the perks for remorting?

Remort resets you to level 3 but lets you rebuild as a new class/guild, keeps all your equipment, and unlocks psionics (four random powers per remort 2-4, all seventeen by remort 5); each life also raises the level cap by one until the final remort at level 59.
what mob has the most powerful weapon in the game and what is it?
The brilliant white light in the Abandoned Cathedral carries the Power of the world, the highest-level weapon obtainable at level 54.

I am having trouble getting gear from high level mobiles. Could you analyze my potential upgrades, from the lowest required player level and suggest what three items would be the easiest for me to obtain so that I can increase my damage.

Your newbie shield (lvl 1) is the easiest swap -- upgrade to a Ceresian kite (lvl 50) from Countess DiLuna in Morgan, then seek the elven gloves (lvl 52) and elven bracelet (lvl 52) from the elven hall guard in the Tombs of Tarin, all within your reach at 52.
Getting gear that is above level 50 is too difficult. Can you suggest gear that would still be upgrades for me, but below level 50?

Swap your newbie shield for a Ceresian kite (lvl 50) from Countess DiLuna, your pegleg for Solgartian battle armor leggings (lvl 50) from Bear Olefsky, and your mud school diploma for the Crystalline Sceptre of Commanding (lvl 50) from Crown Prince Augustus Starfire -- all at level 50 in Morgan.
How about gear that is even lower level than those

Your winter veil mantle (lvl 50) is already best-in-slot; below that, seek the divine breastplate (lvl 51) which replaces your current plate, or downgrade to some black velvet robes (lvl 32), battle helmet (lvl 51), a pair of mithril boots (lvl 39), or a white bracer (lvl 40) -- all significantly lower but less of an upgrade than level 50 items.

Does a players proficiency in a weapon help with reducing damage of that same type of damage from a mobile, or increase it's chancing of being able to parryy, dodge, or block it?
Weapon proficiency increases your damage output with that weapon, not your defense; parry, dodge, and block are separate defensive skills unrelated to what you wield.

What advantages does a player gain from having a high dexterity stat?
High dexterity improves your armor class, attack speed, and success with skills like dodge and parry; thieves especially benefit, but warriors like you gain defensive edge too.
